intra_session_localization.description: Intra-session forest place recognition and 6-DoF localization on real RealtimeTrees tree inventories released by the TreeLoc authors (Oxford Forest dataset). Train: Oxford Evo. Hidden test: Oxford Stein am Rhein, the paper's Table I/III localization setting. The first part of the sequence is the database; later revisits (>= 50 frames after the database ends, within 10 m of a database frame) are the queries.

R_at_1.description: Fraction of evaluated queries whose top-ranked database frame lies within 10 m (xy) of the query.

F1.description: Maximum F1 over score thresholds of the top-1 matches: precision = correct accepted / accepted, recall = correct accepted / all evaluated queries (every evaluated query has a true match).

AUC.description: Area under the precision-recall curve of the top-1 matches traced by the score threshold (same precision and recall as F1; equal scores share one threshold).

R_at_50.description: Fraction of evaluated queries whose estimated 6-DoF relative pose to the returned database frame has translation error <= 0.5 m and rotation error <= 5 deg (paper's R@50).

SR.description: Among queries whose top-1 frame is correct (within 10 m), the fraction whose 6-DoF pose meets the R@50 thresholds.

TE_m.description: Mean 3D translation error (m) over correct top-1 matches that meet the R@50 thresholds (0.5 if none).

RE_deg.description: Mean rotation error (deg, geodesic) over correct top-1 matches that meet the R@50 thresholds (5.0 if none).

TE_all_m.description: Mean translation error (m) of the returned relative pose over all evaluated queries, each capped at 10 m (gym addition; unconditional companion of TE_m).

RE_all_deg.description: Mean rotation error (deg) of the returned relative pose over all evaluated queries, each capped at 180 deg (gym addition; unconditional companion of RE_deg).

_paper_6dof_localization_stein.source: Paper Table III, 6-DoF rows (TreeLoc*, BTC*), Oxford Stein. The gym scores full 6-DoF poses, so these are the comparable localization numbers; the 3-DoF row is kept under results unchanged.

intra_session_localization._notes: results.treeloc / results.btc are the paper's Oxford Stein numbers (Table I place recognition; Table III 3-DoF localization), kept unchanged. results.treeloc_no_alignment is Table V (Stein, 100 TDH candidates, DBH, no alignment). Protocol differences: the gym uses a fixed time split (database = first 50% of Stein frames) instead of every earlier frame, 6-DoF rather than 3-DoF errors, and recall over all evaluated queries for F1/AUC (the released code counts a wrong but rejected top-1 as a true negative), so the paper's F1/AUC are not directly comparable (here F1 <= 2 R@1 / (1 + R@1)).

inter_session_localization.description: Inter-session (temporal change, ~6 months) forest place recognition and 6-DoF localization on the authors' tree inventories of Wild-Places Venman: queries from V-03, database from V-02. Hidden test: the official Wild-Places Venman test regions. Train: frames at least 50 m outside those regions.

inter_session_localization._notes: results are the paper's Table II Wild-Places Venman inter-session means over 12 query-database pairs (the gym uses the V-03 -> V-02 pair only). The paper reports no inter-session localization accuracy. F1/AUC use recall over all evaluated queries (see intra_session_localization._notes).
